title: Criminal Law (Miscellaneous Amendments) Act 2025
summary: Passed 4 Nov 2025; adds discretionary caning for scam mules convicted of laundering scam proceeds under the CDSA; in force 30 Dec 2025.

title: Gazettal of Guideline on AI-to-AI Information Sharing for the Detection or Prevention of Crime
summary: New statutory guideline on sharing information between authorized institutions to detect or prevent crime, listed with HKMA's AML/CFT statutory guidelines.

title: Detection and prevention of potential layering activities in money laundering
summary: AML/CFT circular to licensed corporations and VASPs on detecting and preventing layering in money laundering.

title: Supporting Artificial Intelligence Adoption in AML/CFT
summary: HKMA AML/CFT circular supporting banks' use of AI in AML/CFT.

title: Guidance on risk-based AML/CFT controls for politically exposed persons
summary: HKMA guidance on risk-based controls for politically exposed persons, with 'Smart tips on the treatment of politically exposed persons'.

title: Guidance on combating high-end money laundering
summary: HKMA guidance to banks on combating high-end money laundering.

title: FSTB and SFC conclude consultations on virtual asset dealer and custodian regimes, further consult on two new regimes
summary: Consultation conclusions: new VA dealing and custodian licensing regimes to be legislated under the AMLO (Cap. 615), bill planned for 2026.

title: SFC reprimands and fines Kylin International (HK) Co., Limited $9 million for fund management failures
summary: HK$9m fine; findings include failure to keep records showing compliance with AML/CTF requirements.

title: February 2026 FATF Statement
summary: FATF plenary of 11-13 Feb 2026: high-risk and increased-monitoring lists; also forwarded by SFC circular of 13 Mar 2026.

title: Licensed Fund Management Company And Its Officers Investigated For Suspected Money Laundering And Suspected Failure To Comply With Obligations As A Licensed Capital Markets Services Licence Holder
summary: Capital Asia Investments and its officers investigated for suspected money laundering under CDSA s54; over S$160m of assets seized.

title: Thematic Review of Sanctions Screening Systems
summary: HKMA findings from a thematic review of banks' sanctions screening systems.

title: MAS Issues Prohibition Orders against former Relationship Managers Wang Qiming and Liu Kai
summary: 16- and 7-year prohibition orders on two former relationship managers convicted in connection with the August 2023 money laundering case.

title: Singapore has a robust framework for combatting financial crime according to international body
summary: FATF 5th-round mutual evaluation of Singapore published; Singapore placed on regular follow-up.

title: Circular on Risk-Proportionate Source of Wealth Establishment
summary: Guidance to banks and other FIs on risk-proportionate, efficient source-of-wealth establishment.

title: MAS Imposes $300,000 Composition Penalty on Padang Trust Singapore Pte. Ltd. for AML/CFT Breaches
summary: S$300,000 composition penalty on a licensed trust company for breaches of MAS AML/CFT requirements.

title: Supporting Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Fighting Financial Crime
summary: HKMA AML/CFT circular on adopting AI to fight financial crime.

title: The Wolfsberg Group publishes updated Guidance on the Risk-Based Approach
summary: Updated industry guidance for banks on the risk-based approach to financial crime risk.

title: June 2026 FATF Statement
summary: FATF plenary of 17-19 Jun 2026: high-risk and increased-monitoring lists; also forwarded by SFC circular of 14 Jul 2026.

title: The Wolfsberg Group publishes Guidance on the provision of banking services to non-bank payment service providers (PSPs)
summary: Industry guidance for banks serving non-bank payment service providers.

title: SFC reprimands and fines Victory Securities Company Limited $1.7 million and suspends its responsible officer for regulatory breaches
summary: HK$1.7m fine and RO suspension; the SFC found the firm fell short of the AMLO and AML Guideline by not enquiring into red flags before executing a client's orders.

title: Guidance on risk-based AML/CFT controls for politically exposed persons (Smart Tips version 2.0)
summary: Revised PEP guidance with 'Smart Tips on the Treatment of Politically Exposed Persons_Version 2.0'.

title: Remote on-boarding of individual customers
summary: HKMA AML/CFT circular on remote on-boarding of individual customers.

title: SFC reprimands and fines Zheng Da International Financial Holding Limited $7 million and suspends its responsible officer for regulatory breaches
summary: HK$7m fine and RO suspension for failing to comply with the AMLO and AML Guideline: no due diligence on customer-supplied trading systems, ineffective monitoring of suspicious trading.

title: Anti-bribery & corruption controls for account opening
summary: HKMA circular, filed with its AML/CFT circulars, on anti-bribery and corruption controls at account opening.
